recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Any future bindings or stronger strengths for remaining unbound CodeableConcept elements should be handled by specific BR&R/Vocabulary trackers with approved value sets rather than by broadening FHIR-31543 after publication.
issue_request: FHIR-31543 asked for CodeableConcept bindings across the medicinal-product resource family because most coded fields lacked even example value sets; it was Published/Persuasive for R5 with the resolution that necessary changes had been made.
initial_application: The issue was applied through January 2022 source history: c4105f29435c created MedDef terminology value sets/code systems, bde3eced70c registered related terminology/country binding source, and 9ee11711505a added StructureDefinition bindings across the active resource family. The additional FHIR#31543 description tweak 0897f0699f is R4B-only and not part of current mainline source.
additional_context: The current build uses R5 successor resource names in source/fhir.ini. Representative active source retains bindings across MedicinalProductDefinition, AdministrableProductDefinition, ManufacturedItemDefinition, Ingredient, ClinicalUseDefinition, RegulatedAuthorization, PackagedProductDefinition, and SubstanceDefinition. FHIR-31800 is a duplicate; FHIR-31835 and FHIR-31836 are already represented on the combined branch; later FHIR-37763 and FHIR-39596 explain some remaining unbound coded elements as separate design work.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because the current specification already carries the approved FHIR-31543 binding work and there is no bounded, approved additional source edit for this broad issue.
